stages.name: Straight
hint: The boat is moored: it turns but does not move. The dot goes round once per beat.
Press Space when the dot is in the green, hold for about half a turn, let go.
Do it on every turn: the boat points at the green and stays there.

stages.name: Left
hint: The green has moved to the left. The dot gets there a quarter turn earlier.
Press earlier, when the dot is in the green: the boat turns left.
Shifting the beat is how you steer.

stages.name: Right
hint: The green has moved to the right. The dot gets there a quarter turn later.
Press later, when the dot is in the green: the boat turns right.

done: That is all there is to steering. Press 1 for the first course.
